identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of pCAR-19B in the Treatment of CD19-positive Relapsed/Refractory B-ALL in Children and Adolescents
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study of Anti-CD19 CAR-T Therapy (pCAR-19B) in the Treatment of CD19-positive Relapsed/Refractory B-ALL

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase II clinical study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of pCAR-19 B cell autologous infusion preparation in the treatment of CD19-positive relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a multiple-center, single-arm, open-label study. After meeting the eligibility criteria and enrolling on the trial, patients will undergo leukapheresis for collection of autologous lymphocytes. Once cells have been manufactured, patients will then proceed to lymphodepleting chemotherapy with cyclophosphamide 20mg/kg and fludarabine 25mg/m\^2 for 3 consecutive days followed by the infusion of CD19 CAR T-cells at a target dose of 0.6-2 x10\^6 cells/kg.

armGroups.label: pCAR-19B cells
armGroups.description: Infusion of pCAR-19B cells by dose of 0.6-2 x10\^6 cells/kg

interventions.name: pCAR-19B cells
interventions.description: Drug: pCAR-19B cells； Administration method: intravenous infusion； Subjects will be treated with Fludarabine and Cyclophosphamide before cell infusion.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate after pCAR-19B infusion [Effectiveness]
primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate includes CR, CRi.

secondaryOutcomes.description: MRD-negative ORR within 3 months by flow cytometry as assessed by Independent Review Committee (IRC) and investigator.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Best overall response after pCAR-19B infusion [Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Best overall response means the proportion of patients with the best efficacy (CR or CRi) after pCAR-19B cell therapy.
Overall survival means the time from infusion of pCAR-19B cells to death of subjects from any cause

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of response after pCAR-19B infusion [Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Duration of response means the time from first assessment of CR or CRi to first assessment of disease recurrence or death from any cause, whichever occurs first

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Relapse free survival after pCAR-19B infusion [Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Relapse free survival means time from subject infusion of pCAR-19B cells to first disease relapse or death from any cause (whichever occurs first)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Event free survival after pCAR-19B infusion [Effectiveness]
The incidence of Treatment Emergent Adverse Events (TEAE) of pCAR-19B infusion
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0

secondaryOutcomes.measure: the incidence of adverse events related to treatment of pCAR-19B infusion
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0

secondaryOutcomes.measure: the incidence of adverse event of special interest (AESI) of pCAR-19B infusion
the incidence of RCL of pCAR-19B infusion
secondaryOutcomes.description: RCL Detection: the incidence of Replication Competent Lentivirus.
Analysis using CAR DNA copy number measured by qPCR: the highest concentration of pCAR-19B cells expanded in peripheral blood after administration
Analysis using CAR DNA copy number measured by qPCR: the time to reach the highest concentration;
Analysis using CAR DNA copy number measured by qPCR: Area under the curve at 28 days and 90 days.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Pharmacodynamics data parameters of the degree of clearance
secondaryOutcomes.description: The degree of clearance of CD19-positive B cells at different blood collection time points after cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Pharmacodynamics data parameters of CAR-T-related serum cytokines
secondaryOutcomes.description: the concentration levels of IL-6 at each time point.
Analysis using anti-CAR antibodies measured by Meso Scale Discovery（Electrochemiluminescence）

otherOutcomes.measure: Comparative analysis of 6-month ORR of CAR-T treatment with or without hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
otherOutcomes.description: Independent Review Committee (IRC) and investigator-assessed 6-month ORR, including CR and CRi; Independent Review Committee (IRC) and investigator-assessed 6-month ORR with MRD-negative, including CR and CRi.

otherOutcomes.measure: Assess the Children's growth and development after pCAR-19B infusion
otherOutcomes.description: The subject's height were measured before infusion and 1, 2, 3 months after infusion and every three months thereafter.

otherOutcomes.measure: Assess the Children's growth and development after pCAR-19B infusion
otherOutcomes.description: The subject's weight were measured before infusion and 1, 2, 3 months after infusion and every three months thereafter.

otherOutcomes.measure: The impact of the cellular and molecular features of immune function statu on response and adverse reactions
otherOutcomes.description: The correlation between the detection results of peripheral blood lymphocyte subsets which measured by Cellular immunoassay and the efficacy and safety.

otherOutcomes.measure: Comparative analysis of 6-month RFS of CAR-T treatment with or without hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
otherOutcomes.description: 6-month relapse-free survival (RFS) by Independent Review Committee (IRC) and investigator assessments was statistically compared between the two groups; Relapse free survival means time from subject infusion of pCAR-19B cells to first disease relapse or death from any cause (whichever occurs first).

otherOutcomes.measure: Comparative analysis of 6-month OS of CAR-T treatment with or without hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
otherOutcomes.description: 6-month Overall survival (OS) by Independent Review Committee (IRC) and investigator assessments was statistically compared between the two groups; Overall survival means the time from infusion of pCAR-19B cells to death of subjects from any cause
